column1: # Seeds for t64-result-check suite --inventory INVENTORY, driven by tests/seeded/run-expect.sh.
# Columns: file, exit, rule_id, needle (optional). Every .jsonl file here is a seed and needs a row.
# INVENTORY is a support file (not a seed under --ext .jsonl): the two sorted fixture ids of tests/controls/golden/.
# good.jsonl is the output of `seal` over the two goldens, checked against an independent construction
# (the goldens plus a suite line built with printf and shasum -a 256 over INVENTORY).
# Extra seeds for the remaining suite rules (derived from good.jsonl by hand: reordered, suite line alone,
# first hex digit of inventory_sha256 changed, fixture id renamed, final LF removed, suite line first plus garbage).

column4: suite record must be the last line
